head: Starling Bank voice payments: tell the app who to pay, then approve
dek: Starling Bank customers in the UK can set up a payment by typing or saying it to the Starling Assistant in the app, for example 'Send Mum £20 for lunch'. The assistant prepares the payment and you confirm it with a tap.
details: It's for personal and joint accounts and reaches all retail customers by the end of 2026. Voice works through your phone keyboard's dictation. Small business customers get a similar feature later: upload a photo of an invoice and the assistant sets up the payee and the amount. The assistant can already look at your direct debits and subscriptions, build budgets and create Spaces.
where: UK, Starling personal and joint accounts, rolling out by the end of 2026
means: If you bank with Starling, you can skip the payment screens and set up a transfer in one sentence, but nothing is sent until you approve it.
todo: Tap the Assistant icon at the top left of the Starling app's home screen once the feature reaches you, and check the payee and amount before you approve.
